evidenceMetadata.title: Static migration safety verification
evidenceMetadata.scope: Repository files and operator guidance only; no remote database or backup was queried.

checks.name: Canonical migration catalog is non-empty, uniquely versioned, and has no empty/invalid SQL files
checks.details: 108 repository SQL files; 0 duplicate version(s); 0 invalid/empty file(s).

checks.name: Recovery guidance names one canonical SQL source and blocks stale live-deployment paths
checks.details: The runbook identifies supabase/migrations and treats old bundles/packages as historical evidence.

checks.name: Legacy migration bundler is fail-closed
checks.details: The old generator cannot overwrite or advertise the stale combined SQL artifact.

checks.name: No missing or implicit local database seed source is configured
checks.details: Local Supabase resets do not point to a nonexistent seed.sql or an unreviewed seed set.

checks.name: Environment evidence is explicit and does not claim full history reconciliation
checks.details: Staging and Production are identified by project reference; the KYC change is scoped to Staging.
